purpose: Privacy-only Git metadata and review-path sanitization; no new ceremony contribution.
scope: The 16 commits after the review baseline through the first contribution publication receipt. Earlier repository history is outside this cleanup.
content_changes: Only two review documents had local filesystem paths replaced. All other file payloads, including the announcement, register, signed attestation, cryptographic sources and ceremony binaries, are unchanged in each mapped commit.
signature_policy: The original contribution attestation remains unchanged. Its original code and register revision identifiers resolve through this separately signed mapping.
archive_cleanup: The contribution archive was repacked with normalized owner and timestamps and without extended attributes. Every one of its 16 file payloads is unchanged.
